class.name: NNBTRunNQSQuery
class.brief_description: Action leaf that runs an NQS spatial query asynchronously and writes the results to the blackboard.
class.description: Posts [member nqs_search_space] to [NNNodeQuerySystem] and returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until the query finishes, then writes the winning node, result list, and scores to the configured blackboard keys and returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]. Use this inside a sequence right before checking [NNBTBlackboardHas] and moving to or acting on the found target (for example, finding the best cover point or nearest health pack). If the query finds no matches, the configured keys are cleared and the leaf still returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]; it returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] only if the search space is missing or the query is cancelled or rejected.

members.member: Blackboard key receiving the highest-scoring node (erased if no results matched). Leave empty to skip.
If [code]true[/code], posts the query to the [NNNodeQuerySystem] high-priority queue.
Optional blackboard key receiving the top [member top_n_to_find] scores as a [PackedFloat64Array], best first.
Optional blackboard key receiving the top [member top_n_to_find] nodes as an [Array], best first.
Maximum number of results to write to the blackboard. Must be at least [code]1[/code].
